messages.subject: Flour order for next week
messages.body:
Hi Rosa, I can do the usual delivery Tuesday. I'll send the invoice once it's loaded. Same price as last time (it went up 2% for the new year, sorry!).
Hanna

messages.subject: Re: Flour order for next week
messages.body: Fine by me, Tuesday is good.

messages.subject: Waste invoice - paid?
messages.body: Hello, our records show CW-40912 as unpaid. Please let us know when payment has been made.

messages.subject: Re: Waste invoice - paid?
messages.body: Paid on the 2nd by card online, reference attached.

messages.subject: Re: Waste invoice - paid?
messages.body: Thanks, found it, ignore the reminder.

messages.subject: Brightline Business bill ready
messages.body: Hi, your latest statement is ready to view. Amount 1,388.05 GBP. Direct debit will be collected on 14 February.

messages.subject: How did we do? 2 minutes of your time
messages.body: Thanks for your recent purchase. Please rate your experience from 1 to 10. Your feedback helps us improve.

messages.subject: Your latest home energy bill
messages.body: Your bill for the household supply at your flat is ready: 61.40 GBP, direct debit on the 3rd. View in your account.

messages.subject: Invoice INV-2291 Harbor Flour
messages.body: Invoice INV-2291, 1,540.00 GBP, due 30 March. Includes the new rye flour.

messages.subject: Invoice from Packwell Packaging
messages.body:
Invoice PK-88103
Amount due: 934.00 GBP
Due date: 29 March
Thank you for choosing Packwell.

messages.subject: CityWaste - bin collection invoice
messages.body: Quarterly commercial waste invoice CW-40912: 289.00 GBP, due 13 April. Pay online with the reference on the invoice.

messages.subject: Corrected invoice - Greenfield 5602A
messages.body: Corrected invoice 5602A attached, replaces 5602. New total 617.90 GBP after credit. Due 2 April.

messages.subject: Harbor Flour - reminder INV-2207
messages.body: Hello, this is a friendly reminder that invoice INV-2207 (1,186.50 GBP) fell due on 26 March and we don't see payment yet. If you've already paid please ignore this. Regards, Accounts

messages.subject: Re: Harbor Flour - reminder INV-2207
messages.body: Sorry, it slipped. Transfer going out this afternoon.

messages.subject: Re: Harbor Flour - reminder INV-2207
messages.body: Received with thanks - marking INV-2207 as settled.

messages.subject: Your business energy bill - March
messages.body: Your bill for the bakery premises: 1,420.77 GBP. Pay by direct debit on 15 April. Account ref BB-33021. No action needed unless you want to change your payment date.

messages.subject: Can we split the payment?
messages.body: Hi Hanna, would it be OK to pay the latest flour invoice in two halves? I'll send half now and the rest in 3 weeks.

messages.subject: Re: Can we split the payment?
messages.body: Sure, that's fine, just keep the second half on time please. Hanna

messages.subject: Re: Can we split the payment?
messages.body: Will do, thanks.

messages.subject: Fwd: Sunny Lane Farm eggs
messages.body:
Rosa - the farm sent this to me by mistake. Looks like a bill for eggs. Can you deal with it? Marta

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Ellie <ellie@sunnylanefarm.example>
Sorry for the delay! 40 trays of eggs, 8 each = 320 GBP in total. Could you pay by 28 April? Thanks!!

messages.subject: Kestrel Cleaning invoice
messages.body: Hi Rosa, here's this month's invoice for the evening cleans - 380 GBP. Can you pay by the end of the week? Cheers, Kestrel

messages.subject: Cut your invoicing time in half with Billwise
messages.body: Hi Rosa, thousands of small food businesses use Billwise to create and send invoices in seconds. Start your free 14-day trial today and get your first 3 invoices free.

messages.subject: FINAL NOTICE: invoice unpaid, act now
messages.body: Dear customer, your invoice is overdue. Click the link below within 24 hours to avoid suspension of services. http://secure-pay-verify.example/pay

messages.subject: eggs
messages.body: Hi Rosa, just checking you got my message about the eggs bill? No rush, but the farm shop needs the cash before the weekend :)

messages.subject: Re: eggs
messages.body: Yes! Paying now.

messages.subject: Re: eggs
messages.body: Thank you x

messages.subject: Oven repair quote and invoice
messages.body: Fixed the main deck oven (thermostat + door seal). Parts and labour 465.00 GBP. Invoice OA-1190 attached, 30 days.

messages.subject: Re: Oven repair quote and invoice
messages.body: Great, thank you. Will pass to my bookkeeper.

messages.subject: Re: Oven repair quote and invoice
messages.body: Cheers!

messages.subject: Monthly bookkeeping - what I need from you
messages.body: Hi Rosa, for the month-end I need all supplier bills you've received and which have been paid. Can you forward anything you're holding? Thanks, Marta

messages.subject: Invoice INV-2207 from Harbor Flour Mills
messages.body:
Dear Rosa,

Please find attached invoice INV-2207 for 25 x 25kg strong white flour and 10 x 25kg wholemeal. Total 1,186.50 GBP, payment terms 30 days, so due 11 July.

Kind regards,
Harbor Flour Mills - Accounts

messages.subject: Re: Invoice INV-2207 from Harbor Flour Mills
messages.body: Thanks, got it. I'll pay at the end of the month.

messages.subject: Your statement is ready
messages.body: Your monthly statement for the account ending 4471 is now available. Log in to online banking to view it. We will never ask for your password by email.

messages.subject: 48 hours only: 30% off everything
messages.body: Our biggest sale of the season ends Sunday midnight. Use code SPRING30 at checkout. Free returns.

messages.subject: Packwell - boxes & bags order confirmed
messages.body:
Hi Rosa, your order of 2,000 cake boxes and 5,000 paper bags is confirmed for dispatch Monday. Invoice to follow separately.
Imran

messages.subject: Re: Kestrel invoice
messages.body: Hi, I can't find the invoice for the extra deep clean on the 9th. Can you resend?

messages.subject: Re: Kestrel invoice
messages.body: Oh sorry! Attached. 120 GBP for the deep clean, no invoice number on that one, I wrote it by hand. Pay whenever.

messages.subject: Re: Kestrel invoice
messages.body: Thanks - paid by bank transfer just now.

messages.subject: Packwell invoice PK-88340
messages.body: Invoice PK-88340: 512.25 GBP for bags and tissue paper. Due 10 August.

messages.subject: Your Tuesday brief: 7 stories worth your time
messages.body: Good morning. Today: rate decisions, a new EU rule on data portability, and why everyone is talking about four-day weeks. Read online | Unsubscribe | Manage preferences

messages.subject: Lumen Print - menu boards
messages.body: Hi Rosa, your A2 menu boards are ready for collection. Invoice 7714 for 215.40 GBP attached - net 14 days, due 17 August.

messages.subject: Invoice reminder
messages.body: Hi Rosa, just a gentle nudge on invoice 5531 for 642.18 GBP, I think it's about a week past due. Let me know if you need it resent. Joe

messages.subject: Re: Invoice reminder
messages.body: Already paid on the 20th, I'll send the remittance.

messages.subject: Re: Invoice reminder
messages.body: Got it, found the payment. Thanks!

messages.subject: Disputing line 3 on Lumen invoice
messages.body: Hi, on invoice 7714 you've charged for 6 boards but I only ordered 4. Can you check line 3?

messages.subject: Re: Disputing line 3 on Lumen invoice
messages.body: Checked: you're right, it was a mistake on our side. I'll reissue shortly.

messages.subject: Greenfield Dairy - invoice 5531
messages.body: Invoice 5531 attached: butter, cream and milk for the month, 642.18 GBP. Due on receipt but we give you 14 days, i.e. 9 September.

messages.subject: Your receipt from Fuelstop
messages.body: Receipt for your purchase on 2 September: diesel 54.20 GBP. Card ending 4471. Thank you.

messages.subject: Greenfield Dairy - invoice 5602
messages.body: Hi, invoice 5602 for last month's deliveries: 701.90 GBP, due 23 September. Thanks for your business!

messages.subject: Re: Greenfield Dairy - invoice 5602
messages.body: Hi Joe, the butter on the 12th was short by 2 cases - can you credit that before I pay?

messages.subject: Re: Greenfield Dairy - invoice 5602
messages.body: Good catch, I'll issue a credit note for 2 cases (84.00) and send a corrected invoice.

messages.subject: Packwell statement - overdue items
messages.body: Account statement: PK-88103 (934.00 GBP) is now 12 days overdue. Please arrange payment or contact us if there's an issue.

messages.subject: Re: Packwell statement - overdue items
messages.body: Paying tomorrow, sorry. Cash flow is tight this month.

messages.subject: Re: Packwell statement - overdue items
messages.body: No problem Rosa, thanks for letting me know.
